reddit.title: Improved Water Cost Efficiency in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how flowing water is processed in Provincia. Previously, drying a single cell would require rescanning the entire map, leading to performance issues. Now, only the affected chunk and its immediate neighbors are updated, resulting in a notable reduction in processing time for large lakes. This optimization not only enhances performance but also maintains the visual depth of water features. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Performance Update: Flowing Water Optimization
steam.body: We're excited to share our latest improvements to the flowing water mechanics in Provincia. By optimizing how we handle water presence and reducing unnecessary rescans, we've significantly decreased processing times. This means you can enjoy a more fluid city-building experience without the lag. Read more about these changes in our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
